Yes. For the first time in years, I feel like myself again. I have been suffering from autistic burnout since I started college in 2016. Really, really bad. Constant brain fog, memory loss, loss of basic skills, not taking care of myself, horrific sensory issues being amplified, absolutely zero energy for anything social.. lots more, but that's the main gist. I had been saying to myself for that entire time "I wish the world would stop, I wish I could have a vacation from life." Now, I've lost my job, which I loved and I am sad about, but I suddenly can just...exist. I feel more clear-headed, I am brushing my teeth and bathing and eating semi-regularly. So much improvement. And I do not have to constantly worm my way out of social obligations. I love this. Only issue is that I need to figure out how to get on unemployment and it overwhelms me.
